title: Verify Service Manager can see all pricing and financial data on a work order
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Manager role. (this role has See Financial Data ON).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
steps:
1. Click Work Orders and open a work order.
  2. Check the price on each line and the work order totals.
  3. Open the Finance card.
  4. Open the Stats tab.
expected: All money values are visible: line prices, totals, Finance card amounts, and Stats tab figures show dollar amounts (nothing blank or masked).
